name: g71_faint_source_herb
purpose: G71 regression (decision 0034): Sneasler (M, Mental Herb) is infatuated by Clefable (F, Cute Charm) by Close Combat; Clefable faints in the same step with its faint still queued, so the reference is still in the Update before the faint is processed: the holder eats Mental Herb (-enditem) before the silent end (-end Attract [silent]). A source-HP check would remove the infatuation silently first and never eat the herb.
